title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 21 in B-flat major

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times).

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar.

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Bass: a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every bar.

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject. Bass: the opening of the subject.

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint.

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject and the opening of countersubject 1. Alto: the opening of the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times).

sections.label: Episode 7
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a third every two bars. Bass: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence falling by a third every two bars.

sections.label: Episode 8
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times) and the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Alto: a figure from the subject (5 times), in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times) and the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars.

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject (2 times). Alto: the opening of the subject.
